Photographed 14/09/2022.

This is a photograph of the building that occupies this Listing site address, and of the same building that was photographed for the Images of England project in July 2000. Looking at older Street View images taken prior to the brickwork being painted white (which happened around 2015) it is evidently typical late 20th Century in origin, design and construction. 

Looking back through the Francis Frith archive of Hemel Hempstead that is currently available online, there is one photograph looking south down the High Street that shows the building c 1955. The footprint protruding out into the road beyond the Olde Kings Arms was there but the window openings are completely different with the first floor ones about twice the height of the second floor ones. The modern third floor with its sloping roof is missing too. 

So the photographed front elevation cannot form part of the Listing and it has to be assumed that the remaining fabric of the Listed Building still exists behind the modern façade.
